text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:

- The Norwegian State Church is on a collision course with the ruling Labour Party after it proposed to ban the discrimination of homosexuals in connection with hiring of personnel. Bishop Odd Bondvik said the bible, not the Labour Party programme, provided guidance for the church.
- Norway beat Switzerland 1-0 in a world cup soccer qualifying match on Sunday.
- Oil companies paid nearly 20 billion crowns in taxes to the Norwegian government in 1995, 1.73 billion crowns more than in 1994.
- Managers of Norwegian companies tend to sell subsidiaries at too low a price. Poor planning and preparation in connection with sales cause losses of several billion crowns, a study concludes.

-Ireland and Norway are competing to offer a location for American Atmel's production of microchips. The final decision will be taken under consideration of which country offers the best financial terms.
